heroHeading: Turn Your Crew Into South Park-Inspired Characters
description: Bring your group chat, family, partner, or pet to life with a custom South Park portrait drawn by a human artist. We capture the visual language fans love—simple shapes, bold outlines, snowy backdrops, expressive poses, and comedy-first details—while making you an original character rather than copying a copyrighted character. Hair colour, jacket shades, hats, height order, and facial expressions do the recognisable work, so your finished south park style portrait still feels unmistakably like your crew.

Ordering is easy: upload a clear photo, choose the people or pets you want included, and add notes about clothing, poses, background jokes, or the person who is clearly the Cartman of the group. Straight-on photos are especially useful for getting height relationships right, while goofy expressions and winter outfits can become memorable character details. Multiple people and pets are welcome; just include the relevant photos and explain who is who. Your artist sends a preview within 72 hours, and unlimited free revisions are included so everyone can agree the roast is fair before you download or print it.

Starting at $39.99, Anime Cabinet gives you a personal, hand-drawn alternative to avatar generators and AI filters. It is a fun birthday surprise, roommate farewell, holiday card, anniversary present, or custom wall piece for a South Park fan. Want more inspiration? Explore our guide to a [South Park-inspired custom poster](/blog/south-park-inspired-custom-poster), browse [gift ideas for South Park fans](/blog/best-gifts-for-south-park-fans), or visit the [Anime Cabinet homepage](/) to discover 24 anime and cartoon styles. If you want us to make me a South Park character from your photo, send your image and notes to begin.
